units.zh: 黃翼升，字昌岐，湖南長沙人。
units.en: Huang Yisheng, styled Changqi, was from Changsha in Hunan.
units.literal: Huang Yisheng, courtesy name Changqi, was a native of Changsha, Hunan.

units.zh: 少孤，育於鄧氏，冒其姓，入長沙協標充隊長。
units.en: He lost his parents young and was brought up by the Deng family, adopting their surname; he joined the Changsha garrison banner as a platoon leader.
units.literal: Orphaned in youth, he was raised by the Deng clan and took their surname; he entered the Changsha garrison banner as a squad leader.

units.zh: 咸豐初，從征廣西，曾國籓創水師，調為哨長。
units.en: Early in Xianfeng he campaigned in Guangxi; when Zeng Guofan established the river navy, Yisheng was reassigned as a boat captain.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Xianfeng reign he followed the campaign into Guangxi; when Zeng Guofan founded the naval force, he was transferred to serve as a whistle-boat commander.

units.zh: 四年，從楊岳斌下岳州，敘千總。
units.en: In year four he joined Yang Yuebin's drive on Yuezhou and earned brevet rank as a company commander.
units.literal: In the fourth year he followed Yang Yuebin in the descent on Yuezhou and was recorded for promotion to company commander.

units.zh: 戰於城陵磯，賊以十餘舟來誘，翼升知其詐，追至擂鼓台、荊河腦，伏賊突出，翼升駕舢板奮擊，後隊繼之，賊大敗。
units.en: At Chenglingji the rebels tried to bait him with a dozen boats; Yisheng saw through the trick and chased them to Leigutai and Jinghenao, where ambushers leaped out. He took a sampan straight at them while his rear echelon closed up, routing the enemy completely.
units.literal: Fighting at Chenglingji, the rebels sent more than ten boats as a lure; Yisheng knew it was a ruse and pursued to Leigutai and Jinghenao; concealed rebels sprang out; Yisheng drove a sampan and struck fiercely, the rear column followed, and the rebels were utterly defeated.

units.zh: 轉戰至金口，值賊下游被圍，力戰卻之。
units.en: The campaign moved to Jinkou, where downstream rebels had been trapped; he fought them off in a hard engagement.
units.literal: The fighting shifted to Jinkou; when rebels downstream were besieged, he fought hard and drove them off.

units.zh: 積功擢守備。
units.en: Merit piled up until he was promoted to garrison commander.
units.literal: For accumulated merit he was promoted to garrison commander.

units.zh: 克武漢後，進攻蘄州，翼升自蒜花出戰敗賊，焚其舟，擢都司。
units.en: Once Wuhan fell he pushed on Qizhou; Yisheng struck from Suanhua, routed the rebels, burned their fleet, and was raised to coordinator.
units.literal: After Wuhan was taken, in the advance on Qizhou Yisheng sallied from Suanhua, defeated the rebels, and burned their boats; he was promoted to coordinator.

units.zh: 复蘄州，拔充營官。
units.en: After Qizhou was retaken he was appointed battalion commander.
units.literal: When Qizhou was recovered, he was selected to fill the post of battalion officer.

units.zh: 攻湖口，毀賊船十餘艘。
units.en: In the assault on Hukou he destroyed more than ten rebel vessels.
units.literal: Attacking Hukou, he destroyed more than ten rebel boats.

units.zh: 衝入內湖，賊塞隘口不得退，泊姑塘，迭戰於都昌縣河、雞公湖，焚賊舟。
units.en: He broke into the inner lake, but rebels corked the narrows and pinned him at Gutang; he fought again and again on the Duchang river and Jigong Lake and burned rebel shipping.
units.literal: He charged into the inner lake; rebels blocked the pass so he could not withdraw and anchored at Gutang; he fought repeatedly on the Duchang county river and Jigong Lake and burned rebel boats.

units.zh: 時水師在內湖者無大船，既與外江阻絕，曾國籓令添造，並撥江西長龍、快蟹諸船，以翼升及蕭捷三分領之，各為一軍。
units.en: The inner-lake flotilla had no heavy hulls and was sealed off from the Yangtze main channel, so Zeng Guofan ordered new builds and sent Jiangxi long-dragon and fast-crab craft; Yisheng and Xiao Jiesan each took one of the two new fleets.
units.literal: At that time the naval force in the inner lake had no large ships and was cut off from the outer river; Zeng Guofan ordered additional construction and allocated Jiangxi long-dragon and fast-crab boats; Yisheng and Xiao Jiesan each commanded a separate army.

units.zh: 五年，屢會諸軍攻湖口，未克，蕭捷三戰死，翼升大憤，衝入賊卡，盡毀下鐘岩賊船。
units.en: In year five repeated joint assaults on Hukou failed; Xiao Jiesan fell in battle. Yisheng, furious, rammed the rebel barrier and wiped out every rebel craft at Xiazhongyan.
units.literal: In the fifth year the allied armies repeatedly attacked Hukou without success; Xiao Jiesan was killed in battle; Yisheng was greatly enraged, charged into the rebel stockade, and destroyed all rebel boats at Xiazhongyan.

units.zh: 夜出奇兵數驚賊，賊不出，仍駐軍姑塘。
units.en: He sent night raiders again and again to jolt the rebels, who refused to sally; his force remained at Gutang.
units.literal: By night he sent out raiding parties several times to startle the rebels, but they would not come out; he still kept the army at Gutang.

units.zh: 六年，賊犯撫州，南昌戒嚴，翼升奉檄泊吳城鎮，衛省城。
units.en: In year six rebels struck Fuzhou and Nanchang went on alert; Yisheng was ordered to Wucheng to shield the provincial seat.
units.literal: In the sixth year rebels invaded Fuzhou; Nanchang was placed on alert; Yisheng received orders to anchor at Wucheng Town to guard the provincial capital.

units.zh: 湖口之賊尾至，結土匪窺吳城，翼升分兵由前河包鈔，自赴後河擊陸路之賊，走之。
units.en: Hukou stragglers arrived and teamed with local bandits to probe Wucheng; Yisheng sent a detachment to envelop along the front channel while he hit the land column on the rear river and put them to flight.
units.literal: Rebel remnants from Hukou followed; they joined local bandits to spy on Wucheng; Yisheng divided his force to outflank along the front river while he himself went to the rear river to strike the rebels on land and drive them off.

units.zh: 會彭玉麟至軍，令翼升專攻陸路，敗賊於塗家埠，毀浮橋二、船百餘。
units.en: Peng Yulin joined the command and set Yisheng on the land front; at Tujiabu he routed the rebels and smashed two pontoon bridges and over a hundred boats.
units.literal: When Peng Yulin reached the army he ordered Yisheng to concentrate on the land route; he defeated rebels at Tujiabu and destroyed two pontoon bridges and more than a hundred boats.

units.zh: 賊复冒民船來犯，翼升合軍圍擊，敗之。
units.en: The rebels tried again in disguised civilian craft; Yisheng closed the ring and beat them back.
units.literal: The rebels again disguised themselves in civilian boats to attack; Yisheng united the armies in encirclement and defeated them.

units.zh: 追至德河口，遂會攻南康，直薄城下，火賊船，城賊遁走。
units.en: He chased them to Dehekou, then helped storm Nankang, pressed to the walls, torched rebel shipping, and the garrison ran.
units.literal: Pursuing to Dehekou, he then joined the attack on Nankang, pressed straight under the walls, set rebel boats afire, and the rebels in the city fled.

units.zh: 七年，授直隸提標左營游擊。
units.en: In year seven he received appointment as mobile brigade commander of the Zhili provincial command's left battalion.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed mobile brigade commander of the Left Battalion of the Zhili provincial command.

units.zh: 楊岳斌師至九江，彭玉麟與約夾攻湖口，軍分六隊，翼升率內湖右營當其衝，轉鬥而前。
units.en: Yang Yuebin's corps reached Jiujiang; Peng Yulin coordinated a pincer on Hukou in six columns, with Yisheng's Inner Lake Right Battalion taking the shock and fighting its way forward.
units.literal: When Yang Yuebin's army reached Jiujiang, Peng Yulin arranged a pincer on Hukou; the force was divided into six columns; Yisheng led the Inner Lake Right Battalion to take the brunt and fought forward in rotation.

units.zh: 砲丸冒船過，他營失利，賊逐之，翼升待其還，縱擊，斬殺過當。
units.en: Shot flew over the decks; sister units broke and rebels chased them. Yisheng held his fire until they doubled back, then struck and killed far out of proportion.
units.literal: Cannonballs passed over the boats; other battalions were defeated and rebels pursued them; Yisheng waited for their return and then loosed an attack, killing beyond measure.

units.zh: 賊复乘夜劫營，滅炬待之，殲賊無算，盡毀梅家洲賊船。
units.en: Rebels raided again by night; he doused the lamps and ambushed them, cutting down countless men and destroying every rebel craft at Meijiazhou.
units.literal: The rebels again raided the camp by night; he extinguished the torches and waited; rebels were slaughtered beyond counting and all rebel boats at Meijiazhou were destroyed.

units.zh: 東岸諸軍亦斷湖口鐵鎖，遂克湖口，內外水師復合。
units.en: Eastern-shore units cut the iron chains at Hukou; the position fell and the inner-lake and main-river fleets joined again.
units.literal: The eastern-shore armies also severed the iron chains at Hukou; Hukou was then taken and the inner and outer naval forces reunited.

units.zh: 越日，進奪彭澤賊舟，破小孤山，擢副將。
units.en: Next day he seized rebel shipping at Pengze and stormed Xiaogushan, earning promotion to brigade general.
units.literal: The next day he advanced to seize rebel boats at Pengze and broke Xiaogushan; he was promoted to brigade general.

units.zh: 九年，池州守城賊韋志俊投誠，彭玉麟令翼升往受降，賊酋古隆賢、楊輔清等來爭，擊卻之。
units.en: In year nine Chizhou's garrison commander Wei Zhijun defected; Peng Yulin sent Yisheng to take the surrender. Rebel leaders Gu Longxian and Yang Fuqing rushed to dispute it and were beaten back.
units.literal: In the ninth year the rebel defender of Chizhou, Wei Zhijun, surrendered; Peng Yulin ordered Yisheng to go accept the surrender; rebel chiefs Gu Longxian, Yang Fuqing, and others came to contest it and were driven off.

units.zh: 旋有奸人內應，池州复陷。
units.en: Soon insiders betrayed the city and Chizhou was lost again.
units.literal: Soon thereafter traitors within responded and Chizhou fell again.

units.zh: 十年，曾國籓規江南，奏設淮陽水師，薦翼升領之，即授淮陽鎮總兵。
units.en: In year ten, as Zeng Guofan mapped the Jiangnan campaign, he proposed a Huaiyang river force and named Yisheng to lead it; Yisheng was at once made regional commander of Huaiyang.
units.literal: In the tenth year Zeng Guofan planned for Jiangnan, memorialized to establish the Huaiyang naval force, and recommended Yisheng to command it; he was immediately appointed regional commander of Huaiyang Garrison.

units.zh: 十一年，破賊於黃盆鎮，又敗之方村。
units.en: In year eleven he routed rebels at Huangpen and again at Fangcun.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he defeated rebels at Huangpen Town and again at Fangcun.

units.zh: 進攻銅陵，決城東北堤，從決口入據之。
units.en: Pressing Tongling, he cut the northeast levee and poured in through the breach to seize the town.
units.literal: Advancing on Tongling, he breached the northeast dike of the city and entered through the breach to occupy it.

units.zh: 又進攻無為州，毀泥汊口、神塘河賊壘，無為、銅陵同复，賜號剛勇巴圖魯。
units.en: He pushed on Wuwei, smashed rebel forts at Nizhakou and Shentanghe, and retook Wuwei and Tongling together, receiving the title Gangyong Baturu.
units.literal: He again advanced on Wuwei Prefecture, destroyed rebel stockades at Nizhakou and Shentanghe; Wuwei and Tongling were recovered together, and he was granted the title Gangyong Baturu.

units.zh: 偕王明山循沿江郡縣，克池州，銅陵亦失而復得。
units.en: With Wang Mingshan he swept the Yangtze counties, captured Chizhou, and saw Tongling lost and won back again.
units.literal: Together with Wang Mingshan he swept the riverine prefectures and counties, took Chizhou, and Tongling was lost and recovered again.

units.zh: 運漕鎮濱江通湖，賊踞之以通接濟。
units.en: Yuncao, on the river-lake junction, was held by rebels to keep their supply corridor open.
units.literal: Yuncao Town lay on the river connecting to the lakes; rebels held it to maintain their supply lines.

units.zh: 翼升進擊，諸軍乘之，焚賊舟，賊遁銅城徬。
units.en: Yisheng struck; allied troops followed up, burned rebel craft, and the enemy fled toward Tongcheng.
units.literal: Yisheng advanced to attack; the allied armies pressed the advantage, burned rebel boats, and rebels fled toward Tongcheng.

units.zh: 又偕陳湜攻東關，克之，加提督銜。
units.en: With Chen Shi he stormed Dongguan, took it, and received brevet provincial commander rank.
units.literal: He again joined Chen Shi in attacking Dongguan, took it, and was given the brevet rank of provincial military commander.

units.zh: 同治元年，追賊入巢湖，賊聚湖口以遏歸路，翼升掘堤岸引船出，反拊賊背夾擊，大敗之，城賊遁。
units.en: In Tongzhi year one he chased rebels into Chaohu; they clogged Hukou to cut his retreat. Yisheng breached the levee to float his boats out, hit them from behind in a pincer, and routed them; the garrison bolted.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he pursued rebels into Chaohu Lake; rebels massed at Hukou to block the return route; Yisheng dug through the dike to lead boats out, then struck the rebels' rear in a pincer and defeated them greatly; rebels in the city fled.

units.zh: 進克含山、和州。
units.en: He went on to capture Hanshan and Hezhou.
units.literal: He advanced to take Hanshan and Hezhou.

units.zh: 四月，會攻金柱關，李朝斌臨上游，翼升等遏下游，賊牽於水師，不暇內顧。
units.en: In the fourth month they jointly assaulted Jinzhu Pass: Li Chaobin on the upper river, Yisheng on the lower. The rebels were pinned by the fleet and could not look inland.
units.literal: In the fourth month the allied armies attacked Jinzhu Pass; Li Chaobin held the upper reaches while Yisheng and others blocked the lower; rebels were tied down by the naval force and could not attend to internal affairs.

units.zh: 曾國荃襲克太平，並趨金柱關合攻。
units.en: Zeng Guoquan seized Taiping by surprise and marched on Jinzhu Pass for the combined assault.
units.literal: Zeng Guoquan stormed and took Taiping and also hurried to Jinzhu Pass for the joint attack.

units.zh: 翼升夜督隊逾壕，縱火焚西門，賊突出，揮士卒登岸短兵接，立克金柱關。
units.en: Yisheng led a night column over the ditch and torched the west gate; rebels poured out and he drove his men ashore in close combat, taking Jinzhu Pass at once.
units.literal: Yisheng by night supervised the column over the moat, set fire to burn the west gate; rebels rushed out; he waved the soldiers ashore for hand-to-hand fighting and immediately took Jinzhu Pass.

units.zh: 襲東梁山，一鼓下之。
units.en: He stormed Dongliangshan and carried it at the first rush.
units.literal: He raided Dongliangshan and took it in a single assault.

units.zh: 移師攻蕪湖，賊棄城走。
units.en: He turned on Wuhu; the rebels abandoned the city and ran.
units.literal: He shifted his army to attack Wuhu; rebels abandoned the city and fled.

units.zh: 又擊賊清水河，俘馘千計，以提督記名。
units.en: At Qingshuihe he struck again, taking thousands of heads and prisoners, and was marked for provincial commander.
units.literal: He again struck rebels at Qingshuihe, capturing and beheading thousands; he was recorded for appointment as provincial commander.

units.zh: 五月，克秣陵關、江心洲諸隘，血戰奪九洑洲，軍聲大振。
units.en: In the fifth month he seized Muling Pass and the Jiangxinzhou forts, then in bloody fighting took Jiufuzhou, and the army's fame soared.
units.literal: In the fifth month he took Muling Pass and the passes of Jiangxinzhou; in bloody fighting he seized Jiufuzhou and the army's renown greatly rose.

units.zh: 時李鴻章至上海，規蘇、常，翼升移師會剿，詔署江南水師提督，松江、上海諸水軍悉歸節制。
units.en: Li Hongzhang had reached Shanghai to retake Suzhou and Changzhou; Yisheng shifted south to join him and was named acting Jiangnan naval commander, with every craft from Songjiang and Shanghai under his orders.
units.literal: At that time Li Hongzhang had reached Shanghai to plan for Suzhou and Changzhou; Yisheng moved his army to join the suppression; he was ordered to act as Jiangnan naval commander, and all naval forces of Songjiang and Shanghai were placed under his command.

units.zh: 翼升所部十營，分二營駐浦口，四營駐揚州，親率四營，六月，抵松江，就上海增造舢板、飛劃諸船，移守青浦。
units.en: His ten battalions split—two at Pukou, four at Yangzhou, four with him. In the sixth month he reached Songjiang, ordered more sampans and flying-scull boats built in Shanghai, and moved to hold Qingpu.
units.literal: Yisheng's ten battalions were divided: two garrisoned Pukou, four garrisoned Yangzhou, and he personally led four; in the sixth month he reached Songjiang, had additional sampans and flying-scull boats built at Shanghai, and shifted to guard Qingpu.

units.zh: 賊酋譚紹光合嘉、湖、蘇、昆諸賊圖犯上海，屢撲青浦，翼升與陸軍合擊走之。
units.en: Tan Shaoguang rallied rebels from Jiaxing, Huzhou, Suzhou, and Kunshan to strike Shanghai and hammered Qingpu again and again; Yisheng and the land forces beat them back together.
units.literal: Rebel chief Tan Shaoguang united rebels of Jiaxing, Huzhou, Suzhou, and Kunshan to plot an attack on Shanghai and repeatedly rushed Qingpu; Yisheng joined the land army in combined attack and drove them off.

units.zh: 賊繞犯北新涇大營，又走吳淞，翼升駛往，相持至夜，毀賊營七。
units.en: They swung at the Beixinjing headquarters, then slipped to Wusong; Yisheng raced there, fought through the night, and burned seven rebel camps.
units.literal: Rebels made a detour to attack the great camp at Beixinjing, then went to Wusong; Yisheng sailed there, held them through the night, and destroyed seven rebel camps.

units.zh: 賊犯嘉定及青浦、張堰，分隊往援，且戰且進，至白鶴江，毀橋而還。
units.en: They hit Jiading, Qingpu, and Zhangyan; he sent columns to relieve each point, fighting forward to Baihejiang, wrecked the bridge, and withdrew.
units.literal: Rebels attacked Jiading as well as Qingpu and Zhangyan; he sent detachments to relieve them, fighting as he advanced to Baihejiang, destroyed the bridge, and returned.

units.zh: 翼升兵少，調揚州駐營來會剿。
units.en: Short-handed, he called up the Yangzhou garrison battalions.
units.literal: Yisheng had few troops and called the Yangzhou garrison battalions to join the suppression.

units.zh: 鴻章約合攻黃渡，翼升由趙屯橋截擊，追至三江口，盡平沿岸橋、壘。
units.en: Hongzhang scheduled a joint strike on Huangdu; Yisheng cut them off at Zhaotun Bridge, chased them to Sanjiangkou, and flattened every bridge and redoubt along the bank.
units.literal: Hongzhang arranged a joint attack on Huangdu; Yisheng intercepted from Zhaotun Bridge, pursued to Sanjiangkou, and leveled all bridges and stockades along the shore.

units.zh: 十月，破賊蘆墟、尤家莊、汾湖、三官塘，進距蘇州三十里。
units.en: In the tenth month he cleared Luxu, Youjiazhuang, Fenhu, and Sanguantang and closed to within thirty li of Suzhou.
units.literal: In the tenth month he defeated rebels at Luxu, Youjiazhuang, Fenhu, and Sanguantang, advancing to within thirty li of Suzhou.

units.zh: 常熟守賊駱國忠以城降，譚紹光來爭，陷福山，翼升赴援，進攻河西、白茅、徐六涇諸口。
units.en: Changshu's commander Luo Guozhong surrendered the city; Tan Shaoguang contested it and seized Fushan. Yisheng hurried to help and pushed the passes at Hexi, Baimao, and Xuliujing.
units.literal: The rebel defender of Changshu, Luo Guozhong, surrendered the city; Tan Shaoguang came to contest it and took Fushan; Yisheng went to relieve, advancing to attack Hexi, Baimao, Xuliujing, and other passes.

units.zh: 二年正月，翼升會常勝軍克福山，駱國忠見西山火起，突圍出，圍乃解。
units.en: In the first month of year two he and the Ever-Victorious Army took Fushan; Luo Guozhong saw flames on West Mountain, broke out, and the siege lifted.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year Yisheng joined the Ever-Victorious Army to take Fushan; Luo Guozhong saw fires rise on West Mountain, broke out of encirclement, and the siege was lifted.

units.zh: 楊舍汛為沿江衝要，賊守之以蔽江陰，翼升沿江兜剿，迭破援賊，克之。
units.en: Yangshe, a river choke point shielding Jiangyin, was held by rebels; Yisheng swept the shoreline, broke every relief column, and took it.
units.literal: Yangshe Garrison was a critical point along the river; rebels held it to screen Jiangyin; Yisheng swept along the river in encirclement, repeatedly defeated relief rebels, and took it.

units.zh: 乃會攻江陰，迭破蠡口、陳市。
units.en: He then helped besiege Jiangyin, clearing Likou and Chenshi in succession.
units.literal: He then joined the attack on Jiangyin, repeatedly breaking Likou and Chenshi.

units.zh: 賊酋陳坤書來援，翼升扼江乾誘賊出戰，與郭松林、劉銘傳合擊，大破之。
units.en: Chen Kunshu marched to relieve; Yisheng held the bank to draw them out, then with Guo Songlin and Liu Mingchuan shattered the relief army.
units.literal: Rebel chief Chen Kunshu came to relieve; Yisheng held the riverbank to lure rebels into battle, joined Guo Songlin and Liu Mingchuan in combined attack, and defeated them greatly.

units.zh: 克江陰，賜黃馬褂。
units.en: Jiangyin fell and he received the yellow riding jacket.
units.literal: Jiangyin was taken and he was granted the yellow riding jacket.

units.zh: 九月，由無錫進攻蘇州，詔翼升赴臨淮會剿苗沛霖，鴻章疏留勿遣。
units.en: In the ninth month he pushed from Wuxi on Suzhou; the court ordered him to Linhuai against Miao Peilin, but Hongzhang pleaded to keep him.
units.literal: In the ninth month he advanced from Wuxi to attack Suzhou; an edict ordered Yisheng to go to Linhuai to join suppression of Miao Peilin; Hongzhang memorialized to retain him and not send him away.

units.zh: 諸軍合圍蘇州，薄城下，當齊門、閶門之間，截賊竄路，城賊乞降，予雲騎尉世職。
units.en: Allied columns ringed Suzhou between Qimen and Changmen, sealed every escape route, and the garrison sued for peace; he received the hereditary rank of Fourth Class Cavalry Captain.
units.literal: The allied armies jointly besieged Suzhou, pressed under the walls between Qimen and Changmen, cut off rebel escape routes; rebels in the city begged to surrender; he was granted the hereditary rank of Fourth Class Cavalry Captain.

units.zh: 是年冬，再克無錫，率五營赴臨淮，苗沛霖尋走死，餘黨瓦解，翼升仍回江蘇。
units.en: That winter Wuxi fell again; he took five battalions to Linhuai; Miao Peilin soon died in flight and his bands broke up, and Yisheng returned to Jiangsu.
units.literal: That winter Wuxi was taken again; he led five battalions to Linhuai; Miao Peilin soon fled and died, the remnant party dissolved, and Yisheng returned to Jiangsu.

units.zh: 三年，陳坤書犯常熟，偕郭松林等合擊，賊敗走。
units.en: In year three Chen Kunshu struck Changshu; with Guo Songlin and others he drove the rebels off.
units.literal: In the third year Chen Kunshu invaded Changshu; he joined Guo Songlin and others in combined attack and rebels were defeated and fled.

units.zh: 遣部將王東華等助攻常州，克之，被優敘，詔授江南水師提督。
units.en: He detached Wang Donghua and others to help take Changzhou; the city fell; he was specially commended and appointed Jiangnan naval commander by edict.
units.literal: He sent subordinate generals Wang Donghua and others to assist in attacking Changzhou; it was taken; he received superior commendation and was appointed by edict as Jiangnan naval commander.

units.zh: 曾國籓奏：「江南額設提督一員，兼轄水陸。
units.en: Zeng Guofan wrote: "Jiangnan already has one provincial commander over both land and river forces.
units.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized: "Jiangnan has one established provincial commander who commands both land and water forces.

units.zh: 翼升所授，當是新設，請敕部鑄頒新印。」
units.en: Yisheng's appointment must be a new establishment; please order the ministry to cast and issue a new seal."
units.literal: What Yisheng has been granted must be a newly established post; I request that the ministry be ordered to cast and issue a new seal."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court agreed.
units.literal: The request was approved.

units.zh: 會楊岳斌督師江西，翼升接統外江水師。
units.en: When Yang Yuebin took command in Jiangxi, Yisheng assumed the main-river fleet.
units.literal: When Yang Yuebin commanded the army in Jiangxi, Yisheng took over command of the outer-river naval force.

units.zh: 江寧复，加一等輕車都尉世職。
units.en: After Jiangning was retaken he received the hereditary rank of First Class Commandant of Light Chariots.
units.literal: When Jiangning was recovered, he was given the hereditary rank of First Class Commandant of Light Chariots.

units.zh: 四年，詔翼升赴清江浦防捻匪，至則賊已敗竄山東，進駐邳、宿之間。
units.en: In year four he was ordered to Qingjiangpu against the Nian; the enemy had already broken toward Shandong, so he advanced between Pi and Su.
units.literal: In the fourth year an edict ordered Yisheng to Qingjiangpu to guard against Nian bandits; when he arrived the rebels had already been defeated and fled to Shandong; he advanced to garrison between Pi and Su.

units.zh: 會僧格林沁戰歿，捻氛益熾，犯雉河，翼升駛援，賊又走。
units.en: After Sengge Rinchen's death the Nian flared hotter and struck Zhihe; Yisheng sailed to help and they scattered again.
units.literal: When Sengge Rinchen fell in battle the Nian atmosphere grew fiercer; they invaded Zhihe; Yisheng sailed to relieve and rebels fled again.

units.zh: 五年，回駐江寧。
units.en: In year five he returned to Jiangning.
units.literal: In the fifth year he returned to garrison at Jiangning.

units.zh: 六年，調守清江，東捻賴文光敗竄淮安，翼升督諸軍追擊，文光為道員吳毓蘭所擒。
units.en: In year six he was posted to Qingjiang; eastern Nian leader Lai Wenguang broke toward Huai'an; Yisheng led the pursuit and Wenguang was taken by circuit intendant Wu Yulan.
units.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to guard Qingjiang; the eastern Nian Lai Wenguang was defeated and fled to Huai'an; Yisheng supervised the armies in pursuit; Wenguang was captured by circuit intendant Wu Yulan.

units.zh: 東捻平，論功，被珍賚。
units.en: With the eastern Nian suppressed he was rewarded from the imperial treasury.
units.literal: When the eastern Nian were pacified, merit was discussed and he received imperial gifts.

units.zh: 七年，西捻張總愚竄畿輔，諸軍為長圍困之，鴻章調翼升率師船入運河設防。
units.en: In year seven western Nian Zhang Zongyu broke into the capital approaches; allied columns penned him in a long cordon; Hongzhang sent Yisheng's fleet into the Grand Canal to block him.
units.literal: In the seventh year the western Nian Zhang Zongyu raided the capital region; the armies formed a long encirclement to trap them; Hongzhang transferred Yisheng to lead war boats into the Grand Canal to set defenses.

units.zh: 六月，乘伏汛入張秋口，至德州。
units.en: In the sixth month he rode the summer flood through Zhangqiukou to Dezhou.
units.literal: In the sixth month, riding the summer flood, he entered Zhangqiukou and reached Dezhou.

units.zh: 張總愚奔至，冒官軍喚渡，翼升部將徐道奎察其偽，轟擊之，大軍環集，總愚溺水死。
units.en: Zongyu ran there disguised as government troops asking a ferry; Yisheng's officer Xu Daokui saw through it and opened fire; the main force closed the ring and Zongyu drowned.
units.literal: Zhang Zongyu fled there, disguised himself as government troops calling for a crossing; Yisheng's subordinate Xu Daokui detected the deception and bombarded them; the great army closed in and Zongyu drowned.

units.zh: 西捻平，加雲騎尉世職，合併為三等男爵。
units.en: With the western Nian crushed he received another Fourth Class Cavalry Captain enfeoffment, combined into third-rank baron.
units.literal: When the western Nian were pacified, he was given the hereditary rank of Fourth Class Cavalry Captain, combined into third-rank baron.

units.zh: 長江水師營製定，仍以翼升為提督。
units.en: When the Yangtze river navy was formally organized, Yisheng remained its commander.
units.literal: When the Yangtze naval battalion system was established, Yisheng was still made commander.

units.zh: 彭玉麟終制回籍，長江事宜悉付翼升主之。
units.en: After Peng Yulin finished mourning and went home, Yisheng took charge of all Yangtze affairs.
units.literal: When Peng Yulin completed mourning and returned home, all Yangtze affairs were entrusted to Yisheng to manage.

units.zh: 十一年，詔起玉麟巡閱，劾不職將弁百餘人。
units.en: In year eleven Peng Yulin was recalled to inspect the river service and impeached more than a hundred unfit officers.
units.literal: In the eleventh year an edict recalled Yulin for inspection tour; he impeached more than a hundred derelict officers.

units.zh: 翼升以傷病請代奏乞退，詔斥馭軍不嚴，濫收候補將弁二百餘人之多，念前功，從寬免議，許其開缺回籍養疴。
units.en: Yisheng, pleading wounds and illness, had another submit his resignation; the throne rebuked his lax discipline and hoard of more than two hundred candidate officers, but spared him for past service and let him vacate his post to recover at home.
units.literal: Yisheng, citing wounds and illness, asked another to memorialize begging to retire; an edict rebuked him for lax command of troops and indiscriminately enrolling more than two hundred candidate officers; considering past merit, he was leniently exempted from censure and permitted to vacate his post and return home to nurse his ailments.

units.zh: 光緒十五年，皇太后歸政，以翼升舊勳，予議敘，繪像紫光閣。
units.en: In Guangxu fifteen, when the Empress Dowager handed back rule, Yisheng's old service earned him a merit review and a portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Guangxu the Empress Dowager returned power; because of Yisheng's old merit he was granted merit review and his portrait was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

units.zh: 十八年，复授長江水師提督，入覲，賜紫禁城騎馬。
units.en: In Guangxu eighteen he was reappointed Yangtze commander, presented himself at court, and was granted riding in the Forbidden City.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he was again appointed Yangtze naval commander, attended audience, and was granted riding within the Forbidden City.

units.zh: 二十年，皇太后萬壽慶典，加尚書銜。
units.en: In Guangxu twenty, at the Empress Dowager's birthday celebration, he received brevet minister rank.
units.literal: In the twentieth year, at the Empress Dowager's longevity celebration, he was given the brevet rank of minister.

units.zh: 日本兵事起，翼升由岳州赴江寧籌江防，卒於軍，賜卹，諡武靖，立功地建專祠。
units.en: When war with Japan broke out he left Yuezhou for Jiangning to organize river defense and died on duty; the court granted mourning honors, posthumous name Wujing, and a shrine at the scene of his victories.
units.literal: When hostilities with Japan arose, Yisheng went from Yuezhou to Jiangning to plan river defense and died in the army; funeral gifts were granted, posthumous title Wujing, and a dedicated shrine was built at the place of his merit.

units.zh: 子宗炎，襲男爵，官廣西桂平梧鹽法道。
units.en: His son Zongyan inherited the barony and served as salt commissioner for Guiping and Wuzhou in Guangxi.
units.literal: His son Zongyan inherited the barony and served as Guangxi Guiping-Wuzhou Salt Commissioner.

units.zh: 丁義方，湖南益陽人。
units.en: Ding Yifang was from Yiyang in Hunan.
units.literal: Ding Yifang was a native of Yiyang, Hunan.

units.zh: 入水師，隸彭玉麟部下，積功至守備。
units.en: He joined the river navy under Peng Yulin and rose by merit to garrison commander.
units.literal: He entered the naval force, served under Peng Yulin, and through accumulated merit reached garrison commander.

units.zh: 咸豐八年，克九江，擢都司。
units.en: In Xianfeng eight Jiujiang fell and he was raised to coordinator.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Xianfeng Jiujiang was taken and he was promoted to coordinator.

units.zh: 十年，克建德，賜花翎。
units.en: In year ten he took Jiande and received the peacock feather.
units.literal: In the tenth year Jiande was taken and he was granted the peacock feather.

units.zh: 尋建德复陷，賊數万上犯湖口，勢甚張。
units.en: Jiande was soon lost again; tens of thousands of rebels swept upriver on Hukou in great force.
units.literal: Soon Jiande fell again; tens of thousands of rebels advanced upstream to invade Hukou with very strong momentum.

units.zh: 義方收建德潰兵，簡精壯五百人，分佈守禦，自率水師駐西北門。
units.en: Yifang rallied Jiande's broken troops, picked five hundred stalwarts for the defenses, and himself held the northwest gate with the fleet.
units.literal: Yifang gathered the routed troops of Jiande, selected five hundred elite men, distributed them for defense, and personally led the naval force to garrison the northwest gate.

units.zh: 賊乘銳攻城，義方登陴躬自搏戰，會副將成發翔來援，賊引去。
units.en: The rebels pressed the assault at full heat; Yifang fought on the ramparts himself until Deputy General Cheng Faxiang arrived and the enemy drew off.
units.literal: Rebels took advantage of their momentum to assault the city; Yifang mounted the wall and fought in person; deputy general Cheng Faxiang came to relieve and rebels withdrew.

units.zh: 曾國籓疏言義方膽識過人，部署迅速，詔超擢參將，加副將銜。
units.en: Zeng Guofan praised his nerve and quick dispositions; the court jumped him to colonel with brevet brigade-general rank.
units.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized that Yifang's courage and judgment surpassed others and his deployment was swift; an edict promoted him beyond regular steps to colonel and gave him brevet brigade-general rank.

units.zh: 十一年，駐防小池口，賊自興國來犯，擊卻之。
units.en: In year eleven he held Xiaochikou and beat back a rebel column from Xingguo.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he garrisoned Xiaochikou; rebels came from Xingguo to attack and were driven off.

units.zh: 馳援都昌，解其圍。
units.en: He raced to Duchang and lifted the siege.
units.literal: He hurried to relieve Duchang and lifted the siege.

units.zh: 同治元年，從彭玉麟迭克沿江諸隘，擢副將。
units.en: In Tongzhi year one he followed Peng Yulin in clearing the Yangtze forts one by one and was made brigade general.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Peng Yulin in repeatedly taking riverine passes and was promoted to brigade general.

units.zh: 二年，要擊都昌敗賊，毀其舟，尋解青陽圍，以總兵記名，賜號壯勇巴圖魯。
units.en: In year two he ambushed rebels at Duchang and burned their fleet, then broke the siege of Qingyang; he was marked for regional commander and named Zhuangyong Baturu.
units.literal: In the second year he intercepted and defeated rebels at Duchang and destroyed their boats; soon he relieved the siege of Qingyang; he was recorded for appointment as regional commander and granted the title Zhuangyong Baturu.

units.zh: 七年，授湖口鎮總兵。
units.en: In year seven he was made regional commander of Hukou.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed regional commander of Hukou Garrison.

units.zh: 光緒十九年，卒官。
units.en: He died in office in Guangxu nineteen.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year of Guangxu he died in office.

units.zh: 王吉，湖南衡陽人。
units.en: Wang Ji was from Hengyang in Hunan.
units.literal: Wang Ji was a native of Hengyang, Hunan.

units.zh: 由馬兵累擢守備。
units.en: He rose from cavalry trooper by repeated promotion to garrison commander.
units.literal: From cavalry soldier he was repeatedly promoted to garrison commander.

units.zh: 咸豐九年，入水師，隸彭玉麟部下。
units.en: In Xianfeng nine he joined the river navy under Peng Yulin.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Xianfeng he entered the naval force and served under Peng Yulin.

units.zh: 從屯黃石磯，擊蕪湖賊，戰蟂磯、殷家匯、樅陽，皆有功，擢都司。
units.en: He garrisoned Huangshiji, struck Wuhu rebels, and fought at Xiaoji, Yinjiahui, and Zongyang with distinction, earning promotion to coordinator.
units.literal: He followed in garrisoning Huangshiji, attacked Wuhu rebels, fought at Xiaoji, Yinjiahui, and Zongyang, all with merit, and was promoted to coordinator.

units.zh: 十一年，從克孝感，戰最力，擢游擊，賜號猛勇巴圖魯。
units.en: In year eleven he helped take Xiaogan, fought hardest of all, was made mobile brigade commander, and named Mengyong Baturu.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he followed in taking Xiaogan, fought with greatest effort, was promoted to mobile brigade commander, and granted the title Mengyong Baturu.

units.zh: 克德安、黃州，累擢副將。
units.en: After De'an and Huangzhou fell he rose step by step to brigade general.
units.literal: De'an and Huangzhou were taken and he was repeatedly promoted to brigade general.

units.zh: 同治元年，金柱關之戰，吉率隊蛇行而進，躍上堤埂，破賊壘，以總兵記名。
units.en: At Jinzhu Pass in Tongzhi year one Ji led his men forward in a low crawl, vaulted the dike, smashed the rebel forts, and was marked for regional commander.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, in the battle of Jinzhu Pass, Ji led his column forward in serpentine advance, leaped onto the dike crest, broke rebel stockades, and was recorded for appointment as regional commander.

units.zh: 尋賊復由太平來犯，多方窺伺，吉駕飛劃入湖迎擊，又登岸馳逐。
units.en: Rebels soon probed again from Taiping; Ji took a flying-scull into the lake to meet them and chased them ashore.
units.literal: Soon rebels again came from Taiping to attack, probing from many directions; Ji drove a flying-scull boat into the lake to meet them and also landed to pursue at speed.

units.zh: 經月餘，賊踪始淨。
units.en: After more than a month the rebel presence was finally cleared.
units.literal: After more than a month rebel traces were finally cleared.

units.zh: 援無為州，率水勇登陸，會諸軍​​夾擊敗賊。
units.en: Sent to relieve Wuwei, he landed his sailors and, with the land columns in a pincer, routed the rebels.
units.literal: Relieving Wuwei Prefecture, he led naval fighters ashore and joined the armies in pincer attack to defeat rebels.

units.zh: 破銅城徬水卡，結小划船為橋以濟陸師。
units.en: He smashed the Tongcheng river barrier and lashed small boats into a bridge for the land force.
units.literal: He broke the Tongcheng water barrier, linked small rowboats as a bridge to ferry the land army.

units.zh: 复破陶家嘴、大甲村、岷山岡賊壘。
units.en: He went on to take rebel forts at Taojiazui, Dajiacun, and Minshangang.
units.literal: He again broke rebel stockades at Taojiazui, Dajiacun, and Minshangang.

units.zh: 二年，曾國籓、彭玉麟合疏薦吉勇敢誠樸，堪勝總兵之任，授狼山鎮總兵。
units.en: In year two Zeng Guofan and Peng Yulin jointly praised his courage and integrity and made him regional commander of Langshan.
units.literal: In the second year Zeng Guofan and Peng Yulin jointly memorialized recommending Ji as brave and sincere, fit for regional commander, and he was appointed regional commander of Langshan Garrison.

units.zh: 從克江浦、浦口，奪下關、草鞋峽、燕子磯諸隘，進拔九洑洲，以提督記名。
units.en: He helped take Jiangpu and Pukou, seized Xiaguan, Caoxiexia, Yanziji, and other forts, then Jiufuzhou, and was marked for provincial commander.
units.literal: He followed in taking Jiangpu and Pukou, seized Xiaguan, Caoxiexia, Yanziji, and other passes, advanced to take Jiufuzhou, and was recorded for appointment as provincial commander.

units.zh: 八年，水師凱撤，乞假修墓，乃赴狼山鎮任。
units.en: In year eight, as the fleet withdrew in triumph, he took leave to tend the family graves and then reported to Langshan.
units.literal: In the eighth year the naval force returned in triumph; he begged leave to repair tombs and then went to take up his post at Langshan Garrison.

units.zh: 光緒七年，卒，賜卹。
units.en: He died in Guangxu seven and received mourning honors.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Guangxu he died and funeral gifts were granted.

units.zh: 吳家榜，湖南益陽人。
units.en: Wu Jiabang was from Yiyang in Hunan.
units.literal: Wu Jiabang was a native of Yiyang, Hunan.

units.zh: 入水師，初隸楊岳斌營。
units.en: He joined the river navy, first under Yang Yuebin.
units.literal: He entered the naval force and at first served in Yang Yuebin's camp.

units.zh: 咸豐十年，從黃翼升破賊殷家匯，樅陽，遂歸其部下。
units.en: In Xianfeng ten he followed Huang Yisheng at Yinjiahui and Zongyang and then transferred to his command.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he followed Huang Yisheng in defeating rebels at Yinjiahui and Zongyang and then came under his command.

units.zh: 菱湖、銅陵、泥汊口、運漕鎮、東關諸戰，皆有功，累擢守備。
units.en: He distinguished himself at Linghu, Tongling, Nizhakou, Yuncao, Dongguan, and other fights, rising to garrison commander.
units.literal: At Linghu, Tongling, Nizhakou, Yuncao Town, Dongguan, and other battles he had merit and was repeatedly promoted to garrison commander.

units.zh: 同治元年，從攻金柱關、東梁山、蕪湖，擢都司。
units.en: In Tongzhi year one he fought at Jinzhu Pass, Dongliangshan, and Wuhu and was raised to coordinator.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed attacks on Jinzhu Pass, Dongliangshan, and Wuhu and was promoted to coordinator.

units.zh: 從黃翼升援上海，迭破賊北新涇、四江口，敗援賊於江陰，賜號敢勇巴圖魯。
units.en: With Huang Yisheng he relieved Shanghai, cleared Beixinjing and Sikoujiang, and beat relief forces at Jiangyin, earning the title Ganyong Baturu.
units.literal: He followed Huang Yisheng to relieve Shanghai, repeatedly defeated rebels at Beixinjing and Sikoujiang, defeated relief rebels at Jiangyin, and was granted the title Ganyong Baturu.

units.zh: 領淮陽水師前營，克無錫，擢副將。
units.en: Leading the Huaiyang fleet's forward battalion, he took Wuxi and was made brigade general.
units.literal: He commanded the Forward Battalion of the Huaiyang naval force, took Wuxi, and was promoted to brigade general.

units.zh: 三年，江寧复，錄功，以總兵記名。
units.en: When Jiangning was retaken in year three his merit was recorded and he was marked for regional commander.
units.literal: In the third year Jiangning was recovered, merit was recorded, and he was noted for appointment as regional commander.

units.zh: 四年，追敘克宜興、荊溪、溧陽功，以提督記名。
units.en: In year four his role in taking Yixing, Jingxi, and Liyang was belatedly recognized and he was marked for provincial commander.
units.literal: In the fourth year past merit for taking Yixing, Jingxi, and Liyang was recounted and he was recorded for appointment as provincial commander.

units.zh: 七年，從黃翼升赴直隸防運河。
units.en: In year seven he followed Huang Yisheng to Zhili to guard the Grand Canal.
units.literal: In the seventh year he followed Huang Yisheng to Zhili to guard the Grand Canal.

units.zh: 捻匪平，晉號訥恩登額巴圖魯，授瓜洲鎮總兵。
units.en: After the Nian were suppressed his title advanced to Ne'endenge Baturu and he was made regional commander of Guazhou.
units.literal: When the Nian bandits were pacified his title was advanced to Ne'endenge Baturu and he was appointed regional commander of Guazhou Garrison.

units.zh: 光緒二年，兼署長江水師提督。
units.en: In Guangxu two he also acted as Yangtze naval commander.
units.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he also acted as Yangtze naval commander.

units.zh: 十八年，卒，附祀彭玉麟祠。
units.en: He died in Guangxu eighteen and was enshrined alongside Peng Yulin.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he died and was given ancillary worship at Peng Yulin's shrine.

units.zh: 李成謀，字與吾，湖南芷江人。
units.en: Li Chengmou, styled Yuwu, was from Zhijiang in Hunan.
units.literal: Li Chengmou, courtesy name Yuwu, was a native of Zhijiang, Hunan.

units.zh: 咸豐四年，投效水師充哨長。
units.en: In Xianfeng four he volunteered into the river navy as a boat captain.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he volunteered for the naval force as whistle-boat commander.

units.zh: 從楊岳斌克湘潭、岳州，敘千總。
units.en: He followed Yang Yuebin at Xiangtan and Yuezhou and earned brevet rank as company commander.
units.literal: He followed Yang Yuebin in taking Xiangtan and Yuezhou and was recorded for promotion to company commander.

units.zh: 轉戰湖北，敗賊於倒口，拔沿江木柵，毀鹽關賊船。
units.en: In Hubei he routed rebels at Daokou, tore up riverside palisades, and burned rebel craft at the salt barrier.
units.literal: Fighting in Hubei, he defeated rebels at Daokou, pulled up riverside wooden palisades, and destroyed rebel boats at the salt barrier.

units.zh: 克武漢，擢守備。
units.en: After Wuhan fell he was promoted to garrison commander.
units.literal: When Wuhan was taken he was promoted to garrison commander.

units.zh: 從克田家鎮，成謀追賊，上至武穴，下至龍坪，往來擊賊，殲斃甚眾，擢都司。
units.en: After Tianjiazhen he chased rebels from Wuxue to Longping, killing great numbers in repeated strikes, and was raised to coordinator.
units.literal: Following the taking of Tianjiazhen, Chengmou pursued rebels from Wuxue upstream to Longping downstream, striking back and forth and killing very many; he was promoted to coordinator.

units.zh: 五年，從戰塘角，焚賊舟二百餘，乘風夜抵武昌城下，砲擊賊船，擢游擊。
units.en: In year five at Tangjiao he burned more than two hundred rebel boats, ran before the wind by night to Wuchang, shelled rebel shipping, and was made mobile brigade commander.
units.literal: In the fifth year he fought at Tangjiao, burned more than two hundred rebel boats, rode the wind by night to reach below Wuchang city, bombarded rebel boats, and was promoted to mobile brigade commander.

units.zh: 攻金口，循北岸進拔賊壘。
units.en: At Jinkou he pushed along the north bank and stormed rebel forts.
units.literal: Attacking Jinkou, he advanced along the north bank and took rebel stockades.

units.zh: 又連破賊於壇角、鮎魚套，擢參將，賜號銳勇巴圖魯。
units.en: He cleared Tanjiao and Nianyutao in succession, was made colonel, and named Ruiyong Baturu.
units.literal: He again repeatedly defeated rebels at Tanjiao and Nianyutao, was promoted to colonel, and granted the title Ruiyong Baturu.

units.zh: 成謀身長八尺，力能一手豎大桅，素為胡林翼所器重。
units.en: Chengmou stood eight feet tall and could raise a mainmast with one hand; Hu Linyi had long prized him.
units.literal: Chengmou stood eight chi tall and could raise a great mast with one hand; he had long been valued by Hu Linyi.

units.zh: 至是薦其每戰衝鋒，廉明愛士，堪勝水陸方鎮之任，詔記名，俟軍事稍閒，送部引見。
units.en: Hu now recommended him as a front-line fighter, upright and devoted to his men, fit for a dual land-and-river command; the court noted his name for presentation at the ministry when the war eased.
units.literal: At this time he was recommended as charging in every battle, incorrupt and caring for troops, fit for a land-and-water regional command; an edict recorded his name to await a lull in military affairs before presenting him at the ministry.

units.zh: 六年，扼沙口，斷賊糧道，破賊小河口、青山，燔其輜重。
units.en: In year six he held Shakou, severed rebel supply lines, smashed them at Xiaohekou and Qingshan, and burned their baggage.
units.literal: In the sixth year he held Shakou, cut rebel supply routes, defeated rebels at Xiaohekou and Qingshan, and burned their baggage train.

units.zh: 轉戰蘄州、黃州、廣濟、武穴，下至九江，毀賊舟數百，獲糧械以資軍用。
units.en: He fought through Qizhou, Huangzhou, Guangji, and Wuxue down to Jiujiang, destroying hundreds of rebel boats and seizing grain and arms for the army.
units.literal: He fought at Qizhou, Huangzhou, Guangji, and Wuxue down to Jiujiang, destroyed hundreds of rebel boats, and captured grain and weapons to supply the army.

units.zh: 武漢复，擢副將。
units.en: After Wuhan was retaken he was made brigade general.
units.literal: When Wuhan was recovered he was promoted to brigade general.

units.zh: 七年，會攻九江，追賊至湖口，前隊銳進失利，成謀突入陣中，奪回所失四艘。
units.en: In year seven at Jiujiang he chased rebels to Hukou; when the vanguard overreached and lost four boats, Chengmou plunged in and recovered them.
units.literal: In the seventh year in the joint attack on Jiujiang he pursued rebels to Hukou; the vanguard pressed boldly and was defeated; Chengmou burst into the formation and recovered the four lost boats.

units.zh: 尋授江蘇太湖協副將。
units.en: He was soon appointed deputy commander of the Jiangsu Taihu garrison.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed deputy regional commander of Jiangsu Taihu Garrison.

units.zh: 既克湖口，從楊岳斌順流而下，登陸克望江、東流，疾趨安慶，复銅陵，會江南水師於峽口。
units.en: After Hukou he followed Yang Yuebin downstream, landed to take Wangjiang and Dongliu, raced to Anqing, retook Tongling, and joined the Jiangnan fleet at Xiakou.
units.literal: After Hukou was taken he followed Yang Yuebin downstream, landed to take Wangjiang and Dongliu, hurried to Anqing, recovered Tongling, and joined the Jiangnan naval force at Xiakou.

units.zh: 紅單船方攻泥汊賊壘不能下，岳斌令成謀急棹薄壘，擲火焚其火藥庫，賊遁走，獲其糧械船艦。
units.en: Western gunboats could not reduce the Nizha fort; Yuebin sent Chengmou to row in fast, fire the powder magazine, and drive the rebels off, capturing their stores and shipping.
units.literal: Western gunboats were attacking the Nizha rebel stockade without success; Yuebin ordered Chengmou to row swiftly close to the stockade, cast fire to burn the powder magazine, rebels fled, and grain, weapons, and boats were captured.

units.zh: 胡林翼奏「肅清江面，成謀之功為最，平日事親孝」，特給二品封典。
units.en: Hu Linyi memorialized: "In clearing the river Chengmou's service stood first, and in daily life he was filial to his parents," and the court specially granted him second-rank enfeoffment privilege.
units.literal: Hu Linyi memorialized: "In clearing the river surface Chengmou's merit was greatest, and in daily life he was filial to his parents," and he was specially granted second-rank enfeoffment privilege.

units.zh: 八年，擢福建漳州鎮總兵。
units.en: In year eight he was made regional commander of Zhangzhou in Fujian.
units.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to regional commander of Zhangzhou Garrison in Fujian.

units.zh: 十年，進攻池州，拔殷家匯，毀城外賊壘，破樅陽偽城，加提督銜。
units.en: In year ten he pushed on Chizhou, took Yinjiahui, destroyed outworks, stormed the rebel stronghold at Zongyang, and received brevet provincial commander rank.
units.literal: In the tenth year he advanced on Chizhou, took Yinjiahui, destroyed rebel stockades outside the walls, broke the false city at Zongyang, and was given brevet provincial commander rank.

units.zh: 十一年，陳玉成圍樅陽，擊卻之。
units.en: In year eleven Chen Yucheng besieged Zongyang and was beaten back.
units.literal: In the eleventh year Chen Yucheng besieged Zongyang and was driven off.

units.zh: 同治元年，會陸師拔巢縣、雍家鎮，薄西梁山，斷橫江鐵鎖，奪回要隘，以提督記名。
units.en: In Tongzhi year one, with the land force, he took Chaoxian and Yongjiazhen, pressed Xiliangshan, cut the Hengjiang chains, recovered the key forts, and was marked for provincial commander.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, joining the land army, he took Chaoxian and Yongjiazhen, pressed on Xiliangshan, severed the Hengjiang iron chains, recovered critical passes, and was recorded for appointment as provincial commander.

units.zh: 破賊於魯港、採石磯，克金柱關、蕪湖，賜黃馬褂。
units.en: He routed rebels at Lugang and Caishiji, took Jinzhu Pass and Wuhu, and received the yellow riding jacket.
units.literal: He defeated rebels at Lugang and Caishiji, took Jinzhu Pass and Wuhu, and was granted the yellow riding jacket.

units.zh: 三年，援湖北，破捻匪於羅田。
units.en: In year three he went to Hubei and routed Nian bandits at Luotian.
units.literal: In the third year he relieved Hubei and defeated Nian bandits at Luotian.

units.zh: 五年，署福建水師提督，尋實授。
units.en: In year five he acted as Fujian naval commander and soon received the substantive post.
units.literal: In the fifth year he acted as Fujian naval commander and soon received substantive appointment.

units.zh: 時軍事漸定，整頓營製，會奏裁金門鎮總兵，改為水師副將。
units.en: As the war wound down he reorganized the battalions and jointly proposed abolishing the Jinmen regional commander in favor of a deputy naval commander.
units.literal: As military affairs gradually settled he reorganized battalion regulations and jointly memorialized to abolish the regional commander of Jinmen Garrison, changing the post to deputy naval commander.

units.zh: 裁左營游擊，移右營駐湄州，歸提標統轄。
units.en: The left-battalion mobile commander was cut; the right battalion moved to Meizhou under the provincial command.
units.literal: The Left Battalion mobile brigade commander was abolished; the Right Battalion was moved to garrison Meizhou under provincial-command supervision.

units.zh: 徙前營游擊駐谾口，後營游擊駐鎦門。
units.en: The forward mobile commander was posted to Hongkou and the rear mobile commander to Liumen.
units.literal: The Forward Battalion mobile brigade commander was moved to garrison Hongkou; the Rear Battalion mobile brigade commander garrisoned Liumen.

units.zh: 變通巡哨章程。
units.en: He revised the patrol and sentry regulations.
units.literal: He adapted patrol and sentry regulations.

units.zh: 十一年，彭玉麟整頓長江水師，罷提督黃翼升，薦成謀樸誠堪膺重任，即以代之。
units.en: In year eleven Peng Yulin reorganized the Yangtze fleet, removed Huang Yisheng, praised Chengmou's integrity, and put him in command instead.
units.literal: In the eleventh year Peng Yulin reorganized the Yangtze naval force, dismissed commander Huang Yisheng, recommended Chengmou as sincere and fit for heavy responsibility, and replaced him with Chengmou.

units.zh: 光緒二年，丁母憂，奪情留任。
units.en: In Guangxu two, when his mother died, he was kept on duty despite mourning.
units.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, upon his mother's death, he was retained in office despite mourning obligations.

units.zh: 兩江總督曾國荃奏請江南兵輪悉歸成謀統轄。
units.en: Liangjiang governor Zeng Guoquan asked that all Jiangnan steam warships fall under Chengmou.
units.literal: Liangjiang governor-general Zeng Guoquan memorialized that all Jiangnan steam warships be placed under Chengmou's command.

units.zh: 十六年，萬壽推恩，加太子少保。
units.en: In Guangxu sixteen, at the birthday amnesty, he received Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, at the longevity celebration amnesty, he was given the rank of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 十八年，以病乞歸，尋卒。
units.en: In Guangxu eighteen he retired ill and soon died.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year he begged to retire on grounds of illness and soon died.

units.zh: 詔嘉其在任十餘年，馭軍有法，江面乂安。
units.en: The throne praised his dozen years in command, disciplined troops, and a quiet river.
units.literal: An edict praised his more than ten years in office, disciplined command of troops, and peaceful river surface.

units.zh: 賜卹，建專祠，諡勇恪。
units.en: He received mourning honors, a dedicated shrine, and posthumous name Yongke.
units.literal: Funeral gifts were granted, a dedicated shrine was built, and posthumous title Yongke was given.

units.zh: 李朝斌，字質堂，湖南善化人。
units.en: Li Chaobin, styled Zhitang, was from Shanhua in Hunan.
units.literal: Li Chaobin, courtesy name Zhitang, was a native of Shanhua, Hunan.

units.zh: 由行伍隸長沙協標。
units.en: He entered service in the Changsha garrison banner.
units.literal: From the ranks he entered the Changsha garrison banner.

units.zh: 咸豐四年，曾國籓調充水師中營哨官，從楊岳斌克武昌、田家鎮各城隘，累功擢至參將。
units.en: In Xianfeng four Zeng Guofan made him boat captain of the naval middle battalion; with Yang Yuebin he took Wuchang, Tianjiazhen, and other passes, rising to colonel by merit.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng Zeng Guofan transferred him to serve as whistle-boat commander of the naval Middle Battalion; he followed Yang Yuebin in taking Wuchang and Tianjiazhen and various passes, and through accumulated merit was promoted to colonel.

units.zh: 六年，會內湖水師攻克湖口及梅家洲，從楊岳斌乘勝循下游，埽盪江面，擢副將。
units.en: In year six the inner-lake fleet took Hukou and Meijiazhou; he followed Yang Yuebin downstream, cleared the river, and was made brigade general.
units.literal: In the sixth year the inner-lake naval force jointly took Hukou and Meijiazhou; he followed Yang Yuebin downstream in victory, swept the river surface clean, and was promoted to brigade general.

units.zh: 八年，會攻九江，朝斌以水師登陸助戰，克之。
units.en: In year eight at Jiujiang he landed his sailors to help storm the city and it fell.
units.literal: In the eighth year in the joint attack on Jiujiang, Chaobin landed the naval force to assist in battle and it was taken.

units.zh: 復從楊岳斌進攻安慶，拔樅陽、銅陵賊壘，賜號固勇巴圖魯。
units.en: He again followed Yang Yuebin on Anqing, stormed Zongyang and Tongling, and was named Guyong Baturu.
units.literal: He again followed Yang Yuebin in attacking Anqing, took rebel stockades at Zongyang and Tongling, and was granted the title Guyong Baturu.

units.zh: 十年冬，間道援南陵，回軍攻克東流。
units.en: In the winter of year ten he relieved Nanling by a side road and on the return march took Dongliu.
units.literal: In the winter of the tenth year he relieved Nanling by a side route and on return took Dongliu.

units.zh: 十一年，下茯苓洲、白茅嘴賊壘，會陸軍克無為州，以總兵記名。
units.en: In year eleven he took Fulingzhou and Baimaozui, helped the land army take Wuwei, and was marked for regional commander.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he took rebel stockades at Fulingzhou and Baimaozui, joined the land army in taking Wuwei Prefecture, and was recorded for appointment as regional commander.

units.zh: 再复銅陵，迭克泥汊、神塘河、運漕鎮、東關，加提督銜，授湖北竹山協副將。
units.en: He retook Tongling and cleared Nizha, Shentanghe, Yuncao, and Dongguan in turn, received brevet provincial commander rank, and was made deputy commander of Zhushan in Hubei.
units.literal: Tongling was recovered again; he successively took Nizha, Shentanghe, Yuncao Town, and Dongguan; he was given brevet provincial commander rank and appointed deputy regional commander of Zhushan Garrison in Hubei.

units.zh: 同治元年，擢浙江處州鎮總兵。
units.en: In Tongzhi year one he was made regional commander of Chuzhou in Zhejiang.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was promoted to regional commander of Chuzhou Garrison in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 彭玉麟督水師會陸軍進規沿江要隘，令朝斌率所部遊奕上下游，兜剿環攻，連克金柱關、蕪湖、東梁山，以提督記名。
units.en: Peng Yulin coordinated fleet and army against the Yangtze forts; Chaobin patrolled up- and downstream, encircled rebel positions, and took Jinzhu Pass, Wuhu, and Dongliangshan in turn, earning mark for provincial commander.
units.literal: Peng Yulin directed the naval force with the land army to advance on riverine passes; he ordered Chaobin to lead his troops in patrol up and downstream, encircle and suppress, and in ring attacks successively took Jinzhu Pass, Wuhu, and Dongliangshan; he was recorded for appointment as provincial commander.

units.zh: 曾國籓奏設太湖水師，以朝斌將，令赴湖南造船募勇。
units.en: Zeng Guofan proposed a Taihu fleet under Chaobin and sent him to Hunan to build boats and raise troops.
units.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized to establish the Taihu naval force with Chaobin as commander and ordered him to go to Hunan to build boats and recruit braves.

units.zh: 二年，成軍東下，會諸軍克江浦、浦口，連破草鞋峽、燕子磯賊屯，戰九洑洲，功最，賜黃馬褂。
units.en: In year two his force marched east, helped take Jiangpu and Pukou, cleared Caoxiexia and Yanziji, and won the hardest fight at Jiufuzhou, earning the yellow riding jacket.
units.literal: In the second year the army was formed and marched east; joining allied armies he took Jiangpu and Pukou, successively broke rebel camps at Caoxiexia and Yanziji, fought at Jiufuzhou with greatest merit, and was granted the yellow riding jacket.

units.zh: 朝斌一師，原為規复江、浙而設，九洑洲既克，會黃翼升淮揚水師同援上海，由長江直下，與總兵程學啟會師夾浦，督水師百艘攻沿湖賊壘，下之，進破澹台湖賊壘；
units.en: Chaobin's division had been raised to retake Jiangsu and Zhejiang; after Jiufuzhou he joined Huang Yisheng's Huaiyang fleet for Shanghai, ran down the Yangtze, met Cheng Xueqi at Jiapu, led a hundred boats against lakeside forts, took them, and stormed the Tantai Lake redoubt;
units.literal: Chaobin's division had originally been established to recover Jiangsu and Zhejiang; after Jiufuzhou was taken he joined Huang Yisheng's Huaiyang naval force to relieve Shanghai, descended straight down the Yangtze, united with regional commander Cheng Xueqi at Jiapu, directed a hundred naval boats to attack lakeside rebel stockades and take them, and advanced to break the Tantai Lake rebel stockade;

units.zh: 直逼蘇州，破槃門外賊壘。
units.en: pressed on Suzhou and smashed the forts outside Panmen.
units.literal: pressed straight on Suzhou and broke rebel stockades outside Panmen.

units.zh: 賊酋李秀成率眾七八萬奪寶帶橋，朝斌會陸師合擊，血戰挫之，賊始退。
units.en: Li Xiucheng led seventy or eighty thousand men to seize Baodai Bridge; Chaobin and the land columns bloodily checked them until the rebels drew off.
units.literal: Rebel chief Li Xiucheng led seventy or eighty thousand men to seize Baodai Bridge; Chaobin joined the land army in combined attack, bloodily fought and checked them, and rebels then withdrew.

units.zh: 破援賊於葉澤湖，截竄賊於覓渡橋。
units.en: He routed relief forces at Yeze Lake and cut off fugitives at Midu Bridge.
units.literal: He defeated relief rebels at Yeze Lake and intercepted fleeing rebels at Midu Bridge.

units.zh: 會克五龍橋賊壘，分攻葑門、閶門，晝夜轟擊，李秀成先逸，餘黨以城降。
units.en: He took the Wulong Bridge fort, split his force against Jiangmen and Changmen, shelled day and night; Xiucheng fled first and the rest surrendered the city.
units.literal: He jointly took the Wulong Bridge rebel stockade, divided forces to attack Jiangmen and Changmen, bombarded day and night; Li Xiucheng fled first and the remainder surrendered the city.

units.zh: 李鴻章奏捷，言朝斌迭次苦戰，謀勇兼優，予雲騎尉世職。
units.en: Li Hongzhang reported victory, praising Chaobin's repeated hard fighting and combined courage and counsel, and granted him the hereditary rank of Fourth Class Cavalry Captain.
units.literal: Li Hongzhang memorialized victory, saying Chaobin had fought bitterly again and again with both strategy and courage, and granted him the hereditary rank of Fourth Class Cavalry Captain.

units.zh: 是年冬，會陸師勦賊江、浙之交，克平望鎮，又破賊九里橋，署江南提督。
units.en: That winter, with the land force on the Jiangsu-Zhejiang border, he took Pingwang and broke the enemy at Jiuli Bridge, and acted as Jiangnan commander.
units.literal: That winter, joining the land army in suppressing rebels at the Jiangsu-Zhejiang border, he took Pingwang Town and again defeated rebels at Jiuli Bridge; he acted as Jiangnan commander.

units.zh: 三年，偕程學啟會攻嘉興，朝斌水師由官塘進，破其七壘。
units.en: In year three, with Cheng Xueqi he besieged Jiaxing; Chaobin's fleet advanced up the Guantang canal and smashed seven forts.
units.literal: In the third year, together with Cheng Xueqi he jointly attacked Jiaxing; Chaobin's naval force advanced by Guantang and broke seven stockades.

units.zh: 湖州援賊圖竄盛澤以牽圍師，為朝斌所扼，不得逞，遂克嘉興，實授江南提督。
units.en: Huzhou relief tried to slip through to Shengze to distract the siege; Chaobin blocked them, Jiaxing fell, and he received substantive Jiangnan command.
units.literal: Huzhou relief rebels planned to break through to Shengze to distract the besieging army but were blocked by Chaobin and could not succeed; Jiaxing was then taken and he received substantive appointment as Jiangnan commander.

units.zh: 進規湖州，由夾浦逼長興，賊眾數万，依山築壘，楊鼎勳、劉士奇等與之相持，朝斌督水師登陸襲賊後，夾擊之，盡毀西北沿水賊壘。
units.en: Pressing Huzhou from Jiapu toward Changxing, he faced tens of thousands of rebels fortifying the hills; while Yang Dingxun and Liu Shiji held the front, Chaobin landed his sailors on the rear in a pincer and destroyed every northwest river fort.
units.literal: Advancing on Huzhou from Jiapu he pressed Changxing; rebel forces numbered tens of thousands and built stockades on the hills; Yang Dingxun, Liu Shiji, and others held them in stalemate; Chaobin directed the naval force ashore to strike the rebel rear in pincer attack and destroyed all northwest waterside rebel stockades.

units.zh: 乘勝克長興，复湖州，被珍賚。
units.en: He followed up to take Changxing and retake Huzhou and was rewarded from the treasury.
units.literal: Pressing the victory he took Changxing, recovered Huzhou, and received imperial gifts.

units.zh: 五年，移駐蘇州。
units.en: In year five he moved his headquarters to Suzhou.
units.literal: In the fifth year he moved his headquarters to Suzhou.

units.zh: 軍事甫平，江、浙湖蕩盜多出沒，捕著匪卜小二誅之，轄境晏然。
units.en: With the war barely over, lake bandits haunted Jiangsu and Zhejiang; he seized the notorious Bu Xiao'er and executed him, and his district grew quiet.
units.literal: As military affairs had just settled, bandits in the lakes and marshes of Jiangsu and Zhejiang appeared frequently; he captured the notorious bandit Bu Xiao'er and executed him, and his jurisdiction was tranquil.

units.zh: 八年，請設經制水師，著為成例，移駐松江。
units.en: In year eight he secured a regular standing river force, set it as precedent, and moved to Songjiang.
units.literal: In the eighth year he requested establishment of a regular naval force, made it a standing precedent, and moved headquarters to Songjiang.

units.zh: 光緒四年，兩江總督沈葆楨疏請以外洋兵輪統歸朝斌節制，允之。
units.en: In Guangxu four, Shen Baozhen asked that foreign steam warships fall under Chaobin, and the court agreed.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu, Liangjiang governor-general Shen Baozhen memorialized that foreign steam warships all be placed under Chaobin's command, and it was approved.

units.zh: 十二年，以病乞歸。
units.en: In Guangxu twelve he retired on grounds of illness.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he begged to retire on grounds of illness.

units.zh: 二十年，卒於家，賜卹，建專祠。
units.en: He died at home in Guangxu twenty; the court granted mourning honors and a dedicated shrine.
units.literal: In the twentieth year he died at home; funeral gifts were granted and a dedicated shrine was built.

units.zh: 朝斌本姓王氏，父正儒，生子四，朝斌最幼，襁褓育於李氏。
units.en: Chaobin was born a Wang; his father Zhengru had four sons, and the youngest was raised from infancy by the Li family.
units.literal: Chaobin's original surname was Wang; his father Zhengru had four sons; Chaobin was the youngest and was raised in infancy by the Li clan.

units.zh: 朝斌官江南提督時，牒請歸宗，曾國籓引金史張詩事，謂：「朝斌所處相同，定例出嗣之子，亦視所繼父母有無子嗣為斷。
units.en: As Jiangnan commander he petitioned to revert to the Wang surname; Zeng Guofan cited Zhang Shi's case in the Jin History: "Chaobin's situation matches the rule for an adopted son who leaves the line—it depends on whether the adoptive parents have heirs of their own.
units.literal: When Chaobin served as Jiangnan commander he petitioned to return to his birth clan; Zeng Guofan cited the case of Zhang Shi in the Jin History, saying: "Chaobin's situation is the same; the established rule for a son who has left an adoptive line also depends on whether the adoptive parents have heirs.

units.zh: 今若準歸宗，王氏不過於三子外又增一子，李氏竟至斬焉不祀。
units.en: If he were allowed to revert, the Wangs would simply gain a fourth son, while the Lis would lose their sacrifices entirely.
units.literal: If return to the birth clan were now approved, the Wang clan would merely gain one more son beyond the three, while the Li clan would end with no one to sacrifice to them.

units.zh: 參考古禮今律，朝斌應於李氏別立一宗，於王氏不通婚姻。
units.en: By ancient rite and current law, Chaobin should establish a separate sacrificial line for the Lis and refrain from intermarriage with the Wangs.
units.literal: Referring to ancient rites and present statutes, Chaobin should establish a separate lineage for the Li clan, and with the Wang clan he should not intermarry.

units.zh: 一以報顧復之恩，一以別族屬之義。
units.en: One line to honor his foster parents' care, another to mark the boundary between the two clans.
units.literal: The one to repay the grace of nurture and upbringing, the other to mark the distinction of clan affiliation.

units.zh: 王氏本生父母由朝斌奉養殘年，庶為兩全之道。」
units.en: Chaobin would support his Wang birth parents in their old age, as a compromise that served both families."
units.literal: Wang's biological parents were to be supported in their remaining years by Chaobin, so that both sides might be satisfied."

units.zh: 詔如議行。
units.en: The court approved and carried out the proposal.
units.literal: An edict ordered implementation as proposed.

units.zh: 江福山，湖南清泉人。
units.en: Jiang Fushan was from Qingquan in Hunan.
units.literal: Jiang Fushan was a native of Qingquan, Hunan.

units.zh: 咸豐五年，應募入水師，積功敘把總。
units.en: In Xianfeng five he enlisted in the river navy and rose by merit to platoon leader.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Xianfeng he volunteered for the naval force; through accumulated merit he was recorded as platoon leader.

units.zh: 十一年，克赤岡嶺、菱湖賊壘。
units.en: In year eleven he took Chigangling and the Linghu forts.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he took Chigangling and Linghu rebel stockades.

units.zh: 安慶復，累擢游擊。
units.en: After Anqing was retaken he rose step by step to mobile brigade commander.
units.literal: When Anqing was recovered he was repeatedly promoted to mobile brigade commander.

units.zh: 同治元年，改隸太湖水師，從李朝斌回籍造船，領前營。
units.en: In Tongzhi year one he joined the Taihu fleet, followed Li Chaobin home to build boats, and led the forward battalion.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was transferred to the Taihu naval force, followed Li Chaobin home to build boats, and commanded the Forward Battalion.

units.zh: 浦口、下關、草鞋峽、燕子磯、九洑洲諸戰皆有功，擢參將。
units.en: He distinguished himself at Pukou, Xiaguan, Caoxiexia, Yanziji, Jiufuzhou, and other fights, earning promotion to colonel.
units.literal: At Pukou, Xiaguan, Caoxiexia, Yanziji, Jiufuzhou, and other battles he had merit and was promoted to colonel.

units.zh: 從援上海，破賊於楓涇、烏涇塘。
units.en: He helped relieve Shanghai and routed rebels at Fengjing and Wujingtang.
units.literal: He followed in relieving Shanghai and defeated rebels at Fengjing and Wujingtang.

units.zh: 蘇州复，擢副將，賜號強勇巴圖魯。
units.en: After Suzhou fell he was made brigade general and named Qiangyong Baturu.
units.literal: When Suzhou was recovered he was promoted to brigade general and granted the title Qiangyong Baturu.

units.zh: 三年，從攻嘉興，砲穿左臂，裹創而進，克郡城，擒賊酋，以總兵記名。
units.en: In year three at Jiaxing a round pierced his left arm; he bound the wound and pressed on, took the city, captured a rebel chief, and was marked for regional commander.
units.literal: In the third year he followed the attack on Jiaxing; a cannonball pierced his left arm; he bound the wound and advanced, took the prefectural city, captured a rebel chief, and was recorded for appointment as regional commander.

units.zh: 攻太湖夾浦鎮，砲斷左手指，奮擊破之。
units.en: At Taihu's Jiapu a shell took his left finger; he fought on and took the town.
units.literal: Attacking Jiapu Town on Taihu, a cannon shot severed his left finger; he fought fiercely and broke the position.

units.zh: 進攻湖州久不下，郡東晟舍賊壘最堅，請以偏師往攻，使賊互救，然後大軍乘之。
units.en: Huzhou resisted for months; the Shengshe fort east of the city was the toughest. He asked for a flanking column to draw rebel relief, then let the main force strike.
units.literal: The advance on Huzhou long failed to succeed; east of the prefecture at Shengshe the rebel stockade was strongest; he requested a detached force to attack it so rebels would rescue one another, and then the main army could strike.

units.zh: 福山首先躍壕而入，諸軍繼進，悉毀賊壘。
units.en: Fushan was first over the ditch; the rest followed and destroyed every fort.
units.literal: Fushan was first to leap the moat and enter; the armies followed and destroyed all rebel stockades.

units.zh: 援賊大至，福山摧鋒直前，中砲洞腹，歿於陣。
units.en: Relief arrived in force; Fushan led the charge, took a shell through the belly, and fell on the field.
units.literal: Relief rebels arrived in great force; Fushan drove the vanguard straight forward, was struck by cannon through the abdomen, and died in battle.

units.zh: 事聞，詔視提督例賜卹，死事地建專祠，入祀京師昭忠祠，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職，諡武烈。
units.en: The court granted mourning honors at provincial-commander scale, built a shrine where he fell, enshrined him in the Capital Shrine of Loyalty, gave combined hereditary Commandant of Cavalry and Fourth Class Cavalry Captain ranks, and posthumous name Wulie.
units.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict granted mourning gifts on the scale for a provincial commander, built a dedicated shrine at the place of death, enshrined him in the Capital Shrine of Loyalty, granted the combined hereditary ranks of Commandant of Cavalry and Fourth Class Cavalry Captain, and gave posthumous title Wulie.

units.zh: 劉培元，湖南長沙人。
units.en: Liu Peiyuan was from Changsha in Hunan.
units.literal: Liu Peiyuan was a native of Changsha, Hunan.

units.zh: 咸豐初，以武生入水師，從克湘潭、岳州，敘千總。
units.en: Early in Xianfeng he joined the river navy as a military licentiate, helped take Xiangtan and Yuezhou, and earned brevet rank as company commander.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xianfeng, as a military licentiate he entered the naval force, followed in taking Xiangtan and Yuezhou, and was recorded for promotion to company commander.

units.zh: 戰金口，沉賊船，登岸縱擊，斬賊酋一人。
units.en: At Jinkou he sank rebel craft, landed in pursuit, and beheaded a rebel chief.
units.literal: Fighting at Jinkou, he sank rebel boats, landed and struck freely, and beheaded one rebel chief.

units.zh: 克嘉魚、蒲圻，擢守備。
units.en: After Jiayu and Puqi fell he was promoted to garrison commander.
units.literal: Jiayu and Puqi were taken and he was promoted to garrison commander.

units.zh: 戰田家鎮，培元率十舟窮追四十餘裡，毀賊船，擢都司。
units.en: At Tianjiazhen he led ten boats in a chase of more than forty li, destroyed rebel shipping, and was raised to coordinator.
units.literal: At Tianjiazhen, Peiyuan led ten boats in pursuit for more than forty li, destroyed rebel boats, and was promoted to coordinator.

units.zh: 會攻湖口，斧斷鎖筏，毀湖口賊船。
units.en: At Hukou he axed through the chained barrier and burned rebel boats.
units.literal: In the joint attack on Hukou he axed through the chained rafts and destroyed rebel boats at Hukou.

units.zh: 五年，回援武漢，擊賊鮎魚套，又會鮑超攻小河口，毀賊舟二百有奇。
units.en: In year five he relieved Wuhan, hit rebels at Nianyutao, and with Bao Chao at Xiaohekou destroyed more than two hundred rebel boats.
units.literal: In the fifth year he returned to relieve Wuhan, struck rebels at Nianyutao, and again joined Bao Chao in attacking Xiaohekou, destroying more than two hundred rebel boats.

units.zh: 六年，改陸軍，領長字營，從劉長佑援江西。
units.en: In year six he switched to the land army, commanded the Chang Battalion, and followed Liu Changyou into Jiangxi.
units.literal: In the sixth year he transferred to the land army, commanded the Chang Battalion, and followed Liu Changyou to relieve Jiangxi.

units.zh: 由瀏陽攻萬載，破賊荊樹鋪、栗樹坳，駐大橋。
units.en: From Liuyang he attacked Wanzai, cleared Jingshupu and Lishu'ao, and camped at Daqiao.
units.literal: From Liuyang he attacked Wanzai, broke rebels at Jingshupu and Lishu'ao, and garrisoned Daqiao.

units.zh: 賊潛來襲，培元出奇兵擊之，斬級八百。
units.en: Rebels raided by night; Peiyuan ambushed them and took eight hundred heads.
units.literal: Rebels came in secret to raid; Peiyuan sent out an ambush and struck them, beheading eight hundred.

units.zh: 又破援賊於高城、竹埠。
units.en: He routed relief forces at Gaocheng and Zhubu.
units.literal: He again defeated relief rebels at Gaocheng and Zhubu.

units.zh: 克萬載，營西門外，賊數路來爭，多於官軍數倍。
units.en: Wanzai fell and he camped outside the west gate; rebels attacked from several directions in numbers several times the government force.
units.literal: Wanzai was taken and he camped outside the west gate; rebels came from several routes to contest, outnumbering the government army several times.

units.zh: 培元開壁大戰，斬級千計，擢游擊。
units.en: Peiyuan sallied for a pitched battle and took more than a thousand heads, earning promotion to mobile brigade commander.
units.literal: Peiyuan opened the walls for a great battle and beheaded more than a thousand; he was promoted to mobile brigade commander.

units.zh: 進攻袁州，破南門嶺上賊壘，會蕭啟江破吉安臨江援賊，城賊遁走。
units.en: Pressing Yuanzhou he stormed Nanmenling; when Xiao Qijiang broke Ji'an relief, the garrison ran.
units.literal: Advancing on Yuanzhou, he broke rebel stockades on Nanmenling; when Xiao Qijiang defeated Ji'an-Linjiang relief rebels, rebels in the city fled.

units.zh: 克袁州，以參將留湖南補用。
units.en: Yuanzhou fell and he was kept in Hunan for colonel appointment.
units.literal: Yuanzhou was taken and he was retained in Hunan for appointment as colonel.

units.zh: 七年，會攻吉安，偕曾國荃迎擊援賊於三曲灘，追至硃山槽，賊援复集，夾擊破之，擢副將。
units.en: In year seven at Ji'an he and Zeng Guoquan met relief at Sanquwan, chased them to Zhushancao, shattered a second relief wave in a pincer, and was made brigade general.
units.literal: In the seventh year in the joint attack on Ji'an, together with Zeng Guoquan he met relief rebels at Sanquwan, pursued to Zhushancao; rebel relief gathered again and was defeated in pincer attack; he was promoted to brigade general.

units.zh: 八年，水陸合攻吉安，賊結大筏衝官軍浮橋，培元督師船截擊，砲傷胸，裹創血戰，盡毀其筏。
units.en: In year eight at Ji'an rebels rammed the pontoon with great rafts; Peiyuan intercepted by boat, took a chest wound, bound it, and fought until every raft was destroyed.
units.literal: In the eighth year in combined land-and-water attack on Ji'an, rebels linked great rafts to ram the government pontoon bridge; Peiyuan directed war boats to intercept; a cannon wounded his chest; he bound the wound and fought in blood until all rafts were destroyed.

units.zh: 尋克吉安，以總兵記名。
units.en: Ji'an soon fell and he was marked for regional commander.
units.literal: Soon Ji'an was taken and he was recorded for appointment as regional commander.

units.zh: 是年冬，軍中大疫，培元病，回籍。
units.en: That winter plague swept the army; Peiyuan fell ill and went home.
units.literal: That winter plague broke out in the army; Peiyuan fell ill and returned home.

units.zh: 九年，石達開犯湖南，培元率千人扼桂陽，眾寡不敵，桂陽遂陷。
units.en: In year nine Shi Dakai invaded Hunan; Peiyuan held Guiyang with a thousand men but was overwhelmed and the city fell.
units.literal: In the ninth year Shi Dakai invaded Hunan; Peiyuan led a thousand men to hold Guiyang; outnumbered, Guiyang then fell.

units.zh: 尋率師船溯資水進援寶慶，會諸軍扼河而戰，數破賊，寶慶圍解，援浙江處州鎮總兵，仍留湖南領水師。
units.en: He then led boats up the Zishui to relieve Baoqing, held the river with allied forces, broke the rebels repeatedly and lifted the siege; he was named regional commander of Chuzhou in Zhejiang but stayed in Hunan with the fleet.
units.literal: Soon he led war boats up the Zishui to relieve Baoqing; joining the armies he held the river and fought, repeatedly defeated rebels, the Baoqing siege was lifted; he was transferred to regional commander of Chuzhou in Zhejiang but remained in Hunan commanding the naval force.

units.zh: 十一年，左宗棠進規浙江，立衢州水師，疏薦培元熟諳水陸軍事，請以署衢州鎮，募勇三千赴浙。
units.en: In year eleven Zuo Zongtang pushed into Zhejiang and formed the Quzhou fleet; he recommended Peiyuan for land-and-river command, acting Quzhou commander, and three thousand recruits for Zhejiang.
units.literal: In the eleventh year Zuo Zongtang advanced on Zhejiang and established the Quzhou naval force; he memorialized recommending Peiyuan as versed in land-and-water warfare, requesting him to act as Quzhou commander and recruit three thousand braves for Zhejiang.

units.zh: 同治元年，培元率安武水陸全軍駐常山，控衢州北路，進江山，破大洲賊營。
units.en: In Tongzhi year one Peiyuan's Anwu army held Changshan, blocked Quzhou's north road, advanced on Jiangshan, and smashed the Dazhou camp.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Peiyuan led the full Anwu land-and-water army to garrison Changshan, controlling the northern route to Quzhou, advanced on Jiangshan, and broke the Dazhou rebel camp.

units.zh: 賊竄龍遊，會攻之，賊酋李侍賢大股來援，培元與諸軍合擊，賊敗走。
units.en: Rebels slipped to Longyou; Li Shixian marched up in force; Peiyuan and allied columns beat them back.
units.literal: Rebels fled to Longyou; in the joint attack rebel chief Li Shixian came in great force to relieve; Peiyuan and the armies combined to strike and rebels were defeated and fled.

units.zh: 二年，克湯溪、龍遊，斃賊酋陳廷秀，加提督銜，賜號銳勇巴圖魯。
units.en: In year two Tangxi and Longyou fell, rebel chief Chen Tingxiu was killed, and he received brevet provincial commander rank and the title Ruiyong Baturu.
units.literal: In the second year Tangxi and Longyou were taken and rebel chief Chen Tingxiu was killed; he was given brevet provincial commander rank and granted the title Ruiyong Baturu.

units.zh: 迭克桐廬、富陽，會攻杭州，破賊於萬松嶺，攻清泰門外觀音堂，平其壘。
units.en: He took Tonglu and Fuyang in turn, joined the Hangzhou assault, routed rebels at Wansongling, stormed Guanyintang outside Qingtai Gate, and leveled the forts.
units.literal: He successively took Tonglu and Fuyang, joined the attack on Hangzhou, defeated rebels at Wansongling, attacked Guanyintang outside Qingtai Gate, and leveled the stockades.

units.zh: 城賊出戰，敗之。
units.en: The garrison sallied and was beaten back.
units.literal: Rebels sallied from the city to fight and were defeated.

units.zh: 舁舢板入西湖，砲擊杭城。
units.en: They hauled sampans into West Lake and shelled Hangzhou.
units.literal: Sampans were carried into West Lake and bombarded Hangzhou.

units.zh: 左宗棠以衢州後路要衝，令培元返鎮，其所部水師留攻杭州。
units.en: Zuo sent Peiyuan back to hold Quzhou's vital rear, leaving his fleet to finish the Hangzhou assault.
units.literal: Zuo Zongtang, because Quzhou's rear communications were critical, ordered Peiyuan to return to command; his naval detachments remained to attack Hangzhou.

units.zh: 三年，杭州复。
units.en: Hangzhou was retaken in year three.
units.literal: In the third year Hangzhou was recovered.

units.zh: 培元丁母憂歸，遂不出。
units.en: Peiyuan mourned his mother and never returned to duty.
units.literal: Peiyuan returned home on his mother's death and never returned to service.

units.zh: 光緒十七年，卒。
units.en: He died in Guangxu seventeen.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu he died.

units.zh: 湖南巡撫陳寶箴疏陳培元戰績，賜卹。
units.en: Hunan governor Chen Baozhen cited his battles and the court granted mourning honors.
units.literal: Hunan governor Chen Baozhen memorialized Peiyuan's battle merits and funeral gifts were granted.

units.zh: 論曰：自湘軍水師興，而後得平寇要領。
units.en: Commentary: Once the Hunan river navy arose, the key to suppressing the rebels was in hand.
units.literal: Commentary: From the rise of the Hunan naval force, the essentials for suppressing rebels were thereafter obtained.

units.zh: 後又設淮揚、太湖兩水師，平吳及浙西賴其力。
units.en: Later the Huaiyang and Taihu fleets were added; pacifying Wu and western Zhejiang depended on them.
units.literal: Later the Huaiyang and Taihu naval forces were also established; pacification of Wu and western Zhejiang relied on their strength.

units.zh: 黃翼升、李朝斌當其任。
units.en: Huang Yisheng and Li Chaobin held those commands.
units.literal: Huang Yisheng and Li Chaobin bore those responsibilities.

units.zh: 其後設長江水師為經制，翼升與李成謀迭相更代，為東南重鎮。
units.en: The Yangtze navy was then made a standing force; Yisheng and Li Chengmou alternated in command as the southeast's main river power.
units.literal: Thereafter the Yangtze naval force was established as a standing institution; Yisheng and Li Chengmou alternated in command as a great southeastern stronghold.

units.zh: 平浙東專在陸師，故水師僅有衢州一軍。
units.en: Eastern Zhejiang was won mainly by land troops, so only the Quzhou fleet represented the navy there.
units.literal: Pacification of eastern Zhejiang depended chiefly on the land army, so the naval force had only the Quzhou contingent.

units.zh: 劉培元亦彭、楊舊部，戰績可稱，用並列之。
units.en: Liu Peiyuan, another veteran of Peng and Yang, also earned a solid record and is listed here with them.
units.literal: Liu Peiyuan was also an old subordinate of Peng and Yang; his battle record was notable, and he is therefore listed together.
